question: What cosmic power arises from continually contemplating a smoky-colored form?
premises: The practitioner continually contemplates a smoky-colored form.
This contemplation produces a specific power.
The power extends to the triple world.
inference: Therefore, constant contemplation of a smoky-colored form enables one to shake the triple world.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoky-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
